As with the first two cases of this fault type (LIVE-0fbc4973, LIVE-9608ddd3), the documented confound risk did not manifest here either -- three consecutive clean runs now. Conclusion reached from evidence alone, before reading the injector's own log: settlement.
confirmation_basis: Blind conclusion (settlement) matches the injector's own ground-truth log exactly. Third independent replication of this fault type -- same clean evidentiary shape as both prior cases; the documented Kafka-lag confound has now not manifested in any of the three runs checked.
